approvers: Nobody, I sign it myself, but the client or architect would need to be happy
reason: The aluminium already comes with factory film and I don't budget anything for window protection today. €19 per m² is real money on a small job, and I'd just tape and cover the glass myself for next to nothing.
objection: Why pay €19 a m² when the factory film is already on and a roll of tape and some board costs me almost nothing? My margin on a small job is thin and I'm not adding a new supplier and a 50% deposit for this.
instead: Keep the factory film, tape and cardboard or board over the glass, and have the lads wipe down at handover.
would_change_my_mind: A client or developer specifying it and paying for it as a separate line, or a price near €5 per m² all-in on a trial on one of my floors.
